the following question; what are the Big Data use cases in Telco industry?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

, Telco operators have been collecting Big Data for years, but the real challenge is to find a proper way to analyze and utilize this Big Data to gain insight from it and to make a business decision based on that.

Big Data is being used in the Telco industry in the following domains: (1) Marketing and Customer Experience Management (2) Network Operations and Management (3) Network Planning and Optimization (4) Fraud Management (5) Security (6) Network and Device Analytics (7) Network and Device Performance (8) Network and Device Quality (9) Customer Experience Management and (10) Network and Device Usage.

Big Data is a new opportunity for Telcos to improve their business and to provide better services to their customers, but it also brings challenges to the Telco operators in terms of data management, data storage, and data analysis.

Big Data use cases are not only about data analysis and business insight but also about the business process and how it can be improved with Big Data.

, Telco operators are currently utilizing Big Data in different domains such as Customer Service, Network Management and Operations, Fraud Detection, Security, and Marketing and Sales.

, Big Data has the potential to be utilized in many domains in Telco industry and it is important for Telco operators to be able to handle this Big Data to gain competitive advantage.
